<function name="QueryRow" parent="sql" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Performs the <page>sql.Query</page> and returns the n'th row.

This function is equivalent to safely returning
```lua

```

	<file line="52-L66">lua/includes/util/sql.lua</file>

	</args>
	<rets>

</function>
